answer: Rolling attention escrow. Action weight is capped by a 30-day record of timed, context-dependent judgments; a dune-themed feed item must be answered before context shifts. A sybil farm pays about 20 human-attention minutes daily per identity, since replaying one fable-derived answer credits only one identity. Each garden plot accrues from nonparallel labor, so N identities cost N times the attention budget.
